source.title: The War May Be Ending. What Did Epic Fury Cost?

summary: CSIS puts the war's cost at about $40 billion, of which $26.1 billion is munitions. It also counts 49 Tomahawks fired during skirmishing on June 10, while the ceasefire was nominally in effect.

claims.quote: CSIS also included estimated munitions used related to skirmishing during the ceasefire, including 49 Tomahawks fired on June 10.
claims.note: Firing during the ceasefire, on top of the April tally.

claims.quote: Munitions: $26.1 billion. U.S. forces fired many expensive missiles, making munitions the largest component of the war cost estimate.
